Effectively describes the unique process (carbon application, laser explosion) and the expected mild sandpaper-like exfoliation. Provides good guidance on managing the temporary dryness and supporting the results with proper skincare.

form_data.introduction: This aftercare advice is for a Carbon Laser Facial, also known as a Hollywood Peel. This treatment uses a carbon lotion and a Q-switched laser to deeply cleanse pores, exfoliate dead skin cells, and stimulate collagen. It is a gentle, non-ablative treatment with minimal downtime.

instructions.general_directive: Please follow this aftercare advice to soothe your skin and maximise the brightening, refining results.

sections.title: Immediate Post-Treatment Symptoms and Timeline
sections.content: Your skin will feel warm, similar to a mild sunburn, for 1-2 hours. It will appear slightly pink/red for 4-12 hours. The carbon particles and dead skin cells will create a 'dusty' or 'charred' appearance that will wash away after your first gentle cleanse. Over the next 2-4 days, you may experience light, sandpaper-like flaking as the treated skin exfoliates. Your skin will feel tighter and drier than usual.

sections.title: Cleansing and Exfoliation
items: Wait at least 4 hours before your first gentle cleanse to remove the residual carbon.
Do not scrub aggressively. The flaking skin will come off naturally with gentle cleansing and moisturizing.
DO NOT use any physical exfoliants (scrubs, brushes) or chemical exfoliants (AHA/BHA, retinol) for 5-7 days.

sections.title: Moisturizing and Soothing
sections.content: Your skin will be dry. Apply a gentle, hydrating moisturizer frequently to alleviate tightness and support the skin barrier. A cool compress can be used if the skin feels hot.

sections.title: Sun Protection
sections.content: Your skin will be more photosensitive. You MUST apply a broad-spectrum sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher every day for at least 1 week. Avoid direct sun exposure for 48 hours.

sections.title: Activity Restrictions
items: Avoid strenuous exercise, sweating, saunas, and steam rooms for 48 hours to minimise irritation and redness.
Avoid swimming in chlorinated pools or the sea for 48 hours.

sections.title: Makeup
sections.content: It is best to avoid makeup for 24 hours. You may apply makeup after that if needed, but ensure it is non-comedogenic and applied gently.

sections.title: Purging Possibility
sections.content: As impurities are brought to the surface, a mild breakout (purging) is possible 3-7 days post-treatment. Do not pick; keep the area clean.

sections.title: General Side Effects and Results Assessment
items: If you experience significant pain, blistering, crusting, or signs of infection, contact your practitioner.
Immediate results include a visible glow and smoother texture. Over the next week, as exfoliation completes, skin will appear brighter, pores less visible, and fine lines reduced.
Optimal results are achieved with a series of 3-6 treatments spaced 2-4 weeks apart.
This treatment is excellent for oily, congested skin and overall rejuvenation with no real downtime.
